About EKSPAN

Independent engineering from Sheffield

Our design engineers, workshop and specialist site teams work together on civil, structural and mechanical projects. We help clients build new infrastructure and keep existing assets in service.

Meet the team

From bridge bearings to wider infrastructure

EKSPAN grew out of Glacier Bearings. That background in structural components now supports a wider range of work, including surveys and monitoring, temporary works, structural repairs and specialist installations.

We support clients across highways, rail, marine and industrial infrastructure. Our engineers assess existing structures and design components for manufacture in our Sheffield workshop. Our specialist site teams carry out installation, maintenance and repairs.

How we work with clients

Bring us in early to assess options and site constraints, or commission a defined part of the job.

Principal contractor

Take responsibility for delivering an agreed package of works, from planning through to installation.

Specialist subcontractor

Work with your project team on tasks such as temporary works, controlled jacking and structural repairs.

Design and supply partner

Design, manufacture and supply bearings, joints or bespoke assemblies from our Sheffield workshop.

Inside the Sheffield workshop

Our engineers and workshop team work together on the details that affect manufacture and installation. The workshop handles CNC machining, welded fabrication and assembly before components are sent to site.

How we take responsibility

Environmental management

We consider material use, waste and service life in design and manufacture. EKSPAN publishes its environmental policy and holds ISO 14001 accreditation.

People and communities

We aim to provide a supportive workplace and consider the impact of our projects on the people working on them and the communities around them.
